practicalCriteria: The purpose names the task and result, and the scope states what is in and out
Every chemical has a label or SDS reference, and every dilution is copied from that source
Every step has an observable check and a stated response if the check fails
Records, record retention and one named change approver are stated
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
evidenceRequired: copies or references of labels and SDS for each listed chemical
trial record from a user who ran the procedure
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work when a listed product has no label or SDS available
Stop work when a step's check cannot be completed
Stop work when a condition named in the stop or escalate section is met, and make the area safe first
